title: Pima Bajo language
extract: Pima Bajo is a Mexican indigenous language of the Piman branch of the Uto-Aztecan language family, spoken by around 1,000 speakers in northern Mexico. The language is called Oʼob Noʼok by its speakers. The closest related languages are Oʼodham and the O'othams.
